properties: Single-wall B-flute 2.5-3.0 mm; good stacking strength, poor against corner impacts on heavy glass; kerbside recyclable.
Wet-pressed fibre, typical wall 3.0-4.5 mm; brittle at base corners when walls are flat and unribbed, impact strength improves with ribs; kerbside recyclable.
Recycled PET or PP, 0.12-1.8 mm; tough and puncture-prone in thin film; recyclable if single polymer.
Virgin PS/ABS moulding 2.5-3.0 mm; best impact protection, not kerbside recyclable.
Recycled kraft 80-120 gsm; light, recyclable, low protection.
LDPE film 30-50 micron; cheap, not kerbside recyclable.
